description:
Rebind the four `enforced-by` bindings in `invariants.toml` (three unique targets across four bindings) from their current form to the new `@/rule/<self-id>` or `@/gate/<key>` addressable-item form. Add a resolution check that runs over the seed invariant registry and fails if any `enforced-by` binding does not resolve to a real rule or gate item.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: all four `invariants.toml` `enforced-by` bindings are rebound to `@/rule/...` or `@/gate/...` addresses.
- [hard] REQ-02: a resolution check over the seed invariant registry fails on any unresolved `enforced-by` binding.

Blast radius: `invariants.toml`'s four `enforced-by` string values; the invariant-projection code path that reads and resolves the `enforced_by` field.
title: Rebind invariant enforced-by bindings to addressable items
